_comment: Persistence-matching experiment. This config is separate from
configs/matrix.json so the recorded dataset is never touched: it is run
with `runner matrix --config configs/persistence.json --results-base
persistence_control`, which writes to results/persistence_control/.
Purpose: the primary comparison holds workload, replica count and
network constant but each implementation persists consensus state in its
own way (HashiCorp Raft to BoltDB, etcd Raft to a fsynced WAL, both
EPaxos implementations in memory). This experiment varies persistence
WITHIN each implementation, so a difference between the two protocol
families can be checked against a persistence-matched comparison instead
of being attributed to the leader/leaderless structure by default.
Every mode used here is provided by the implementation itself; none is
invented by the lab:
hashicorp -> durable = raft-boltdb BoltStore (the recorded baseline)
memory  = raft.NewInmemStore + raft.NewInmemSnapshotStore
etcd      -> durable = adapter write-ahead log (batched write + fsync)
memory  = raft.NewMemoryStorage only (adapter -no-wal)
original  -> durable = upstream -durable (stable-store file + fsync)
memory  = upstream default (in-memory replica)
nvb       -> memory  = epaxos.NewMemoryStorage (the library default)
durable = NOT OFFERED: the library exposes only the Storage
interface with an in-memory implementation. The
cell is skipped and reported, never filled with a
new mechanism.
So the 2x2 is filled for both Raft implementations and for EPaxos A,
and the one missing cell (EPaxos B / durable) is an explicit, reported gap.
The `defaults` block is a verbatim copy of configs/matrix.json's defaults
(same CPU/memory allocation, keyspace, timeouts, Raft timeouts, seed and
10 repetitions), so the persistence runs use the same benchmark
methodology as the recorded runs and differ only in the storage path.
7 and 9 replicas are not included: this host has ~2 GB free, and
`make resource-contention` reports that the large replica counts are NOT
per-replica CPU saturated in the recorded telemetry, so they would not
add a persistence contrast worth the runtime here.
